children: LG Electronics India's diversified product mix and phased pass-through of higher input costs have put the company on a growth trajectory ahead of its peers, Jefferies analysts Sonali Salgaonkar and Saurabh Kulkarni say in a note. Premiumization is driving sales in refrigerators, air conditioners and televisions, while exports registered a 30% year-over-year growth in the June quarter despite global uncertainties. Jefferies expects a 21% compound annual growth rate in earnings per share over fiscal 2026-29, aided by higher capacity utilization. It raises the stock's target price to 1,895 Indian rupees from 1,810 rupees and maintains its buy rating. Shares are up 0.8% at 1,650 rupees.(venkat.pr@wsj.com)
